description.value:
"Set your feet. The line forms on you."

The Bulwark is the wall — and the wall runs on Surge, like everyone, but yours arrives the hard way: every time you take Integrity damage you bank +1 Surge (max +2/round (+3 with Polarity Mastery, Mountain)). You eat the blow and turn it into the power to anchor, erupt, or hold. At zero Surge you still stand in the way; soak one hit and your turn opens up.

The Fortress (spent via Surge — Bulwark only)

  • Brace Wall (1) — you and adjacent allies gain DR equal to Tier this round.

  • Bulwark Stance (6) — adjacent allies share your defenses until your next turn.

  • Anchor (5) — you and one ally become immune to forced movement and crowd-control until next round.

  • Mass Aegis (8) — allies within Tier squares gain +Tier to every defense this round.

  • Sanctum (9) — immune to one damage type for a round.

  • Mythic Stand (10) — invulnerable until the start of your next turn.

These were always the Bulwark's birthright; they no longer leak into everyone else's menu. The old Frame and Ruin tricks are Surge spends too — Absorb (1), Push (1), Shockwave Footing (2), Catastrophic Entry (3), Siege Works (2) and Ruin to Renewal (3) — and your Path adds three more of its own.
